topic: Ambient / game music packs (menu, room, relax) under CC0 or CC-BY
method: Web search only. Pages on opengameart.org, itch.io and freemusicarchive.org were NOT opened: WebFetch failed with DNS resolution errors (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) for opengameart.org and *.itch.io hosts. next_steps: Allow opengameart.org, *.itch.io and freemusicarchive.org in session network settings, then verify licenses and track lengths on each page.
Start with R4-001, R4-009, R4-010, R4-012, R4-013, R4-015, R4-021, R4-041 (the strongest CC0/CC-BY candidates for menu, room and relax).
Reject any single track under 60 s unless it belongs to a multi-variant pack.
